title: Red Hat Security Advisory: curl security update
description: Multiple security vulnerabilities affecting the curl packages in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.8 Extended Update Support have been addressed. These include proxy credential disclosure via redirects to unauthenticated proxies, authentication bypass due to incorrect HTTP Negotiate connection reuse, credential leaks via reused proxy connections during HTTP redirects, and information disclosure via incorrect Proxy-Authorization header reuse. The update fixes these issues to prevent unauthorized access and credential leakage.
